target_moa.text: Romosozumab is a sclerostin inhibitor; it inhibits the action of sclerostin (a regulator of bone metabolism that inhibits the Wnt signaling pathway), increasing bone formation and, to a lesser extent, decreasing bone resorption.

citations.quote: EVENITY inhibits the action of sclerostin, a regulatory factor in bone metabolism. EVENITY increases bone formation and, to a lesser extent, decreases bone resorption.

Sclerostin, secreted by osteocytes inhibits the canonical Wingless-related integration site (Wnt) signaling pathway in bone and decreases osteoblast-mediated bone formation as well as promotes osteoclast function and bone resorption.
Romosozumab-aqqg is a humanized monoclonal antibody (IgG2) produced in a mammalian cell line (Chinese Hamster Ovary) by recombinant DNA technology that binds to and inhibits sclerostin.

key_safety.text: The most common adverse reactions (>=5%) were arthralgia and headache. summary.text: BLA 761062 was a standard (non-priority) review submitted as a BLA resubmission after FDA issued a Complete Response Letter on July 13, 2017 for the original BLA over cardiovascular safety concerns. The resubmission (received July 9, 2018) was reviewed with an Advisory Committee meeting held January 16, 2019 (voting 15 yes / 3 different indication / 1 no), and the drug was approved with a boxed warning for cardiovascular risk and a required post-marketing cardiovascular safety study (PMR 3595-1).
